entity_raw.definition_raw:
You need only a swallow of strong drink to bring you back from the brink of death.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13.

Benefit(s): If you are dying and a creature gives you at least a sip of alcohol (a standard action for an adjacent creature), you immediately stabilize.
